title: SkillProbeProblem
description: Why skills.probe could not reach the repository: authentication (the forge refused the credential, or asked for one no forge account gives), not_found (no such repository or branch), network (the host could not be reached in time), git_missing (git is not installed on the environment's computer; data.line holds the spawn's ENOENT), git_failed (git failed otherwise; data.line holds its fatal: line).
